body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 3 – 4 hours, over a route of about 2 km. It starts at 91A Rue de Rivoli, Rue de Rivoli, 91A. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Ticket to the Louvre (priority green queue for visitors with tickets). The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Ellen as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> With this in-app audio tour and entrance ticket, discover the highlights of the magnificent
> Louvre. Enter the museum through the Pyramid or the Carrousel entrance at
> 99, rue de Rivoli — take the green priority queue for visitors with tickets.
>
> Explore this extraordinary collection of art spanning from prehistoric times to Antiquity,
> through the Middle Ages to the Renaissance and up to 1848. Beyond the famous Mona
> Lisa, the museum reveals the treasures of human civilization: ancient Babylonian
> antiquities, graceful Greek sculptures, medieval European art, and Renaissance
> masterpieces.
>
> Your journey begins with vestiges of a medieval fortress, then takes you to iconic
> sculptures such as the Venus de Milo, the Winged Victory of Samothrace (Nike), and Michelangelo’s Slaves.
>
> At the heart of the Louvre is its most celebrated masterpiece — the enigmatic Mona
> Lisa. Discover the secrets behind her famous smile and the genius of Leonardo da
> Vinci. The tour concludes with Near Eastern artifacts revealing the origins of writing.
> Designed for easy navigation, this tour focuses on the museum’s most essential works,
> the iconic artworks that have marked our civilization.
>
> There is a free wifi service, ‘Louvre_Wifi_Gratuit’. It lasts one hour and can be renewed as many times as needed.
>
> Please note: this tour is not affiliated with the Louvre. It is created by an independent
> author. The entry ticket to the museum is included for your convenience at no extra
> charge.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €48.00. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 99 ratings and 42 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
